about: Campaign Mode's debate (docs/CAMPAIGN-MODE.md section 14.1): week 3, four rounds. Prep slots cover a topic; 'weak' preps the candidate's own weak spot (the Mayor's question and any scandal). The manager calls a style each round.

questions.text: Rent in Queens went up again. What would you actually do about it?
The 7 train was late 41 times last month. Why should riders believe you?
People want to feel safe walking home at night. What's your plan?
Who's paying for your campaign, and what do they want?
Let's talk about this week's headlines about your campaign.
Papa-Dani: "My friend here owns eleven towers. Neighbor, when did you last pay rent?"
Papa-Dani: "The professor has a chart for everything. Does she have a heart for anyone?"
Papa-Dani: "Frankie, I love you, but it's not 1985. Do you even have an email?"
Papa-Dani: "Kaylee, honey, City Hall isn't a content zone. What's your budget plan?"

facts.label: Facts
facts.good: Numbers, sources, a plan. The crowd nods.
facts.bad: Facts, unprepared. A number came out wrong.

preview.get: Strong if you prepped this topic

charm.label: Charm
charm.good: A joke, a smile, a story. The room warms up.

attack.label: Attack
attack.good: Straight at the Mayor's record. It lands.
attack.bad: An attack with nothing behind it. Booing.

preview.get: Hits hard with intel on him
Gets you off a weak spot

own.label: Own it
own.good: "I got that wrong." The room respects it.
own.bad: Owning something nobody asked about. Odd.

preview.why: Only works on a real problem
